name: Awoken
detailed_description:
🔨 Build. Survive. Descend. Fight. ⚔️

In Awoken, the world above offers safety, crafting, and progression, but true power lies in the depths below. Venture into randomly generated dungeons, where every run is a battle for survival against relentless enemies, deadly traps, and unpredictable encounters.

💀 Death is not the end—but it will cost you. Will you take the risk for greater rewards?

Key Features:

  • 🏠 Safe Haven – Build, upgrade, and customize your base where you can craft, store loot, and prepare for the next descent.

  • ⚔️ Diverse Classes – Choose from multiple playstyles, each with unique abilities, strengths, and weaknesses.

  • 🎲 Ever-Changing Dungeons – No two runs are the same. Each dungeon is procedurally generated, filled with monsters, traps, and secrets.

  • 🛠️ Loot & Crafting – Find powerful weapons, Armor, and artifacts to help you survive. Upgrade, enchant, and customize your gear.

  • 🎭 Risk vs Reward – The deeper you go, the greater the treasures—but death means losing everything you carry.

  • 🤝 Solo or Co-op – Brave the depths alone or team up with friends to take on the abyss together.

The surface is your refuge. The dungeons are your battlefield. How long can you survive?

🔥 Prepare. Descend. Awaken.

short_description: In Awoken, prepare in the safety of your base, then descend into randomly generated dungeons filled with monsters, traps, and treasures. Loot big, but risk it all. Anything you carry is lost on death, but your base, upgrades, and stored items remain. How far will you go?
